title: Performance Configuration
description: Optimize your HP OMEN laptop's power settings, thermal profiles, and display configuration for the best performance in gaming and productivity tasks.

steps.title: OMEN Performance Profiles
steps.content:
OMEN Command Center offers three performance profiles. Choose based on your current activity:

**🌿 Comfort Mode**
Balanced performance with quiet operation
Best For: Web browsing, Office work, Video streaming
Fan Noise: Low | Performance: Moderate | Thermals: Cool

**⚖️ Default Mode**
Optimal balance between performance and thermals
Best For: Light gaming, Productivity, Everyday use
Fan Noise: Medium | Performance: Good | Thermals: Warm

**🚀 Performance Mode**
Maximum performance for demanding tasks
Best For: Gaming, Video editing, 3D rendering
Fan Noise: High | Performance: Maximum | Thermals: Hot

infoBox.title: Quick Switch
infoBox.content: Use keyboard shortcut Fn + P to quickly cycle through thermal profiles without opening OMEN Command Center.

steps.title: Power Plan Configuration
steps.content:
Configure Windows and NVIDIA power settings for optimal performance.

**Windows Power Plan**
Location: Settings → System → Power & battery
Recommended: High Performance or Balanced
Steps:
1. Open Windows Settings (Win + I)
2. Navigate to System → Power & battery
3. Under Power mode, select "Best performance"
4. For laptops on battery, consider "Balanced"

**OMEN Command Center Profile**
Location: OMEN Command Center → Performance Control
Recommended: Performance Mode for gaming
Steps:
1. Open OMEN Command Center
2. Go to Performance Control tab
3. Select your preferred mode
4. Optionally create custom profiles

**NVIDIA Control Panel**
Location: Right-click desktop → NVIDIA Control Panel
Recommended: Prefer Maximum Performance
Steps:
1. Open NVIDIA Control Panel
2. Go to Manage 3D Settings
3. Set "Power management mode" to "Prefer maximum performance"
4. Apply settings

steps.title: Display Optimization
steps.content:
Configure display settings for the best gaming experience.

**Refresh Rate**
Higher refresh rates provide smoother visuals
Location: Settings → Display → Advanced display → Choose a refresh rate
💡 Use your highest available refresh rate (144Hz, 165Hz, or 300Hz)

**G-Sync / FreeSync**
Eliminates screen tearing during gameplay
Location: NVIDIA Control Panel → Set up G-SYNC
💡 Enable for smoother gaming experience

**HDR**
High Dynamic Range for better colors and contrast
Location: Settings → Display → HDR
💡 Enable if your display supports it and you prefer vibrant colors

steps.title: RGB Lighting Configuration
steps.content:
Customize your OMEN's RGB lighting through OMEN Command Center:

1. Open OMEN Command Center and navigate to the Lighting tab

2. Choose from preset lighting effects or create custom colors

3. Adjust brightness and speed for animated effects

4. Save your configuration as a custom profile

infoBox.title: Battery Tip
infoBox.content: Disabling RGB lighting can slightly improve battery life on unplugged use.
